The interval uses historical first-print dispersion combined with explicit policy take-up uncertainty, implying 17.4\u201321.2 million.\"},{\"type\":\"text\",\"content\":\"Tail stress: Below 17.4 million could occur if low-income filing and take-up are weak, the enacted provision is implemented late or narrowly, employment among eligible parents falls, or SSN and qualifying-child rules exclude more returns than modeled.
